map.输入车速、制动减速度、反应时间与道路坡度，计算反应距离、制动距离及总停车距离，用: Enter vehicle speed, braking deceleration, reaction time and road gradient to compute reaction distance, braking distance and total stopping distance, for safe-driving assessment and accident analysis.
map.制动协调时间 (s，通常 0.2，可填 0): Brake coordination time (s, usually 0.2, enter 0 to skip)
map.制动距离与初速的平方成正比：车速从 50 提到 100 km/h，制动距离约变为: Braking distance scales with the square of initial speed: going from 50 to 100 km/h multiplies it about fourfold, and with reaction distance added on top the total stopping distance grows even more alarmingly. Slowing down is the most effective safety measure.
map.普通驾驶者从发现到踩下刹车的反应时间约 0.75~1.5 s，含感知、判断与动作: An ordinary driver needs about 0.75~1.5 s from spotting a hazard to pressing the pedal, covering perception, decision and action; distraction, fatigue or poor night recognition make it longer. Gap calculations often assume a 1 s baseline, but leave a wider margin in practice.
map.💡 跟车时距建议：干燥路面 ≥ 2 s，雨天 ≥ 3 s，冰雪 ≥ 4~6 s。: 💡 Suggested following gaps: ≥ 2 s on dry roads, ≥ 3 s in rain, ≥ 4~6 s on snow and ice. Working in "time gap" rather than "distance" adapts itself to speed.
map.安全驾驶培训时，输入车速、反应时间与路面，算反应距离、制动距离与总停车距离，理解: In safe-driving training, enter speed, reaction time and surface to compute reaction, braking and total stopping distance and see how far it grows when speed doubles.
map.事故分析或保险定责中，按痕迹与限速反推刹车是否及时、车距是否足够。: In accident analysis or insurance liability, work back from marks and speed limits to judge whether braking was timely and the gap sufficient.
map.恶劣天气行车前，用湿滑附着系数估算加长的停车距离，调整跟车距离。: Before driving in bad weather, estimate the longer stopping distance from the slippery grip coefficient and adjust your following distance.
map.干湿路面停车距离对比: Stopping distance on dry vs wet roads
map.车速 100km/h（27.78m/s）、反应时间 1s、干燥 μ≈1.0；反应: At 100km/h (27.78m/s) with a 1 s reaction time on dry asphalt μ≈1.0: reaction distance = 27.78×1 ≈ 27.8m, braking distance = v²/(2μg) = 27.78²/(2×1.0×9.81) ≈ 39.3m, total stopping ≈ 67.1m. If it rains and μ≈0.6, braking distance rises to ≈65.5m and total stopping ≈93.3m, about 39% more than dry.
map.车速翻倍为什么距离不止翻倍？: Why does doubling speed more than double the distance?
map.制动距离与初速平方成正比，车速从 50 提到 100km/h，制动距离约变为 4: Braking distance scales with the square of initial speed, so going from 50 to 100km/h multiplies it about fourfold; adding the fixed reaction distance makes total stopping distance grow even more. That is why high-speed crashes are far more severe, and why slowing down is the most effective safety measure.
map.反应时间一般取多少？: What reaction time should be assumed?
map.普通驾驶者发现到踩刹车的反应时间约 0.75–1.5s，含感知、判断、动作；分心: An ordinary driver needs about 0.75–1.5 s from noticing to braking, covering perception, decision and action; distraction or fatigue lengthens it. Gap calculations often assume 1 s, but leave a wider margin in practice, especially at high speed.
map.制动距离按峰值附着系数理论值计算，实际还受轮胎、载荷与 ABS 介入影响: Braking distance is computed from the theoretical peak grip coefficient; real results also depend on tires, load and ABS intervention
